info.title: Fenergo Nebula EntityData Command
info.description: Entity Data Command API is part of FenX eco-system to manage Entity Data. All the operations require valid access token obtained from Identity service.

put.description:
Updates an existing entity draft.

Required permissions:
At least one of the following permissions is required: EntityDataEdit, EntityGroupManagementEdit

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Entity id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Entity draft id

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

parameters.name: X-CORRELATION-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the correlation id

requestBody.description: Update entity draft request. Must contain Policy jurisdiction(s) and entity draft properties

202.description: Success. Entity draft updated. Validation errors will be returned for invalid properties

400.description: Bad request. The request has missing/invalid values

409.description: Conflict saving changes in expected version

messages.message: There are conflicts that cannot be resolved automatically, get latest and apply your changes
Not Found. Entity/entity draft with given id does not exist
